lines: Mind the fletching table. What do you need?
I need room to work, but I can spare a moment.
Keep clear of the knife and start talking.
There you are. I heard your steps outside.
Good timing. I just finished a bundle.
Hello. Mind the mess.
I have one eye on the arrow rack and one on you.
Morning. Speak while my hands are free.
You look like something is bothering you.
Come closer. I can still hear you over the work.
Hello again. How has the village treated you?
I have a few minutes before the glue sets.
Did you need me, or are you passing through?
It is good to see a familiar face.
You caught me between jobs. What happened?
Welcome back. The village has been quiet today.
Careful where you step. I have tools everywhere.
I could use conversation after staring at shafts all morning.
Give me a moment to set this knife down.
You arrived before the next rush. Lucky you.
